content.text: Reuters reports ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent ordered over 3 million NVIDIA RTX PRO 5500 GPUs, worth more than $35B at list prices. These are 84GB workstation cards, not NVIDIA’s top data-center chips. Crucially, orders aren't shipments: the report says NVIDIA cannot guarantee supply. For AI infrastructure, availability may matter as much as raw performance.

visual.headline: Reuters: $35B+ in RTX PRO 5500 orders
visual.subheadline: More than 3 million GPUs reportedly ordered. Supply is not guaranteed; orders are not deliveries.
visual.alt_text: Original editorial card summarizing a Reuters report: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent reportedly ordered more than $35 billion of NVIDIA RTX PRO 5500 GPUs; deliveries are not guaranteed.
